_comment: What Kind of Retiree Are You? A lighthearted scored quiz for retirement books. Every question offers exactly four answers, one for each retirement style (explorer, tinkerer, social, napper), so no style can win on the structure of the quiz: each gets one chance per question and one point per pick. Variety comes from structure, not paraphrase: every requested question gets its own brief (a retirement topic and a question shape, sampled by seed). A blind second call then sorts every answer into a style without being told which is which; a question survives only when that sort matches the writer's, and the checker calls it balanced and suitable. Budgets arrive on the request (frontend/src/utils/studio/what-kind-of-retiree/content.ts); limits below are the hard bounds. blockedTerms keep sensitive topics and publishing risks off the page; assumptionTerms keep the quiz from assuming a spouse, grandchildren, wealth, a house or an office career; putDownTerms keep the Professional Napper affectionate; revealTerms stop an answer from naming its own style. qualifierWords are dropped before two texts are compared.

locale.nativeLine: - Write in clear, warm, natural English for adults and retirees.
locale.otherLine: - Write every question, answer and description in language locale '{locale}', natural for that language.

outcomes.explorer: new places, travel near or far, discovery, curiosity and trying unfamiliar things
outcomes.tinkerer: hands-on projects, building, fixing, crafting, learning a skill and experimenting
outcomes.social: friends, family, neighbours, clubs, gatherings, community and doing things together
outcomes.napper: rest, comfort, a slow pace, quiet routines and enjoying having fewer obligations
